newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT still reviewing listings split.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT still reviewing listings split.

text.p: Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (Dutch PTT) said on Tuesday it was still mulling a split into two separate listings for its core postal and telecoms arms but that a decision could take months to work out.
"The question is whether a KPN shareholder would have a greater return if he had two separate shares than if he had one single share," KPN chairman Wim Dik told a results news conference.
"This is a major question and this is why we have to raise it with our shareholders. Should they give a 'yes' then we will have to take that answer into account." he said.

"Should this lead to a total split up is a question which should be looked into very thoroughly. We have to find an answer to this strategic question first internally and then externally. We think that in the second half of the year we will have found that answer," said Dik.
He refused to speculate over the possible outcome of this process: "We're doing this in a very peaceful framework, it could still go either way.
KPN said last December it was examining the possibility of separate listings for its post and telecoms arms.

Dik told the Wall Street Journal newspaper last year that the company was considering a situation under which KPN would become a holding company for separately traded postal and telecoms units, but was in no hurry to make a decision.
